title: Decode XORed Permutation
description: There is a hidden integer array `perm` that is a permutation of the first `n` positive integers (`1` through `n`), where `n` is guaranteed to be odd. It was encoded into an array `encoded` of length `n - 1` such that `encoded[i] = perm[i] ^ perm[i + 1]` for all `0 <= i < n - 1`. Given `encoded`, reconstruct and return the original permutation `perm`.
constraints: A unique valid permutation perm of 1..n is guaranteed to exist.
hints: Compute `total = 1 ^ 2 ^ ... ^ n`, which equals `perm[0] ^ perm[1] ^ ... ^ perm[n - 1]`.
XORing the odd-indexed entries `encoded[1] ^ encoded[3] ^ ... ^ encoded[n - 2]` equals `perm[1] ^ perm[2] ^ ... ^ perm[n - 1]`, immediately revealing `perm[0]`.
